# XMP golden fixture

`mwg-reference.xmp` is the exact output of `xmp::write::build_packet` for the
sample in `build_packet_matches_exiftool_validated_golden` (rating, label,
location, two keywords, one named face region). It is generated by the code, not
hand-written.

Its MWG-Regions shape (center-based normalized `stArea` under `mwg-rs:RegionList`
with pixel `AppliedToDimensions`) was validated against exiftool, the MWG
reference parser that digiKam, Lightroom and darktable rely on.

## Re-validate after an intentional format change

```bash
VIDERE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p videre --bins build_packet_matches_exiftool_validated_golden
exiftool -G1 -a -s -struct crates/videre/tests/fixtures/xmp/mwg-reference.xmp
```

Confirm exiftool still reports `XMP-mwg-rs RegionInfo` with `Name=Ayşe`,
`Type=Face`, a normalized `Area`, and `AppliedToDimensions W=4000 H=3000`, then
commit the regenerated fixture. exiftool is not in CI (it is not a build
dependency), so this manual step is the guard against emitting XMP a real tool
cannot read.
